newsitem.title: CYPRUS: Turk Cypriot leader catches cold, cancels meeting.
newsitem.headline: Turk Cypriot leader catches cold, cancels meeting.

text.p: Turkish Cypriot leader Rauf Denktash cancelled a meeting with United Nations envoy Gustave Feissel on Friday after catching a cold, U.N. sources said.
"He has got a cold. It is not serious," an official in Denktash's office told Reuters. He did not say when Denktash would resume his normal work routine.
Denktash heads the Turkish Republic of Northern Cyprus, a breakaway state on the divided island recognised only by Turkey.

Feissel is due to start a new round of proximity talks between Greek and Turkish Cypriots on Monday aimed at reaching "common ground" on the Cyprus question which could pave the way for direct negotiations between the two sides.
Friday's meeting was to get the go-ahead from the Turkish Cypriot leader to proceed with the talks.
The island has been divided since Turkey invaded the north in 1974 in response to a brief Greek Cypriot coup in Nicosia instigated by the military junta ruling Greece at the time.
